fields.name: Sri Lanka Air Force Museum
fields.short_description: Aviation history and aircraft displays at Ratmalana.
fields.description: The Sri Lanka Air Force Museum is located at SLAF Ratmalana. It presents the history of the Sri Lanka Air Force and its predecessor, the Royal Ceylon Air Force. Confirm current public access requirements before visiting.
fields.opening_hours_note: Open daily except Mondays and Public Holidays.
fields.opening_hours:
Tuesday - Sunday: 8:30 AM – 4:15 PM
Monday: Closed
fields.google_maps_query: Sri Lanka Air Force Museum, Ratmalana, Sri Lanka
fields.visitor_information:
Ticket Prices (Local):

Adults (18 years and over): LKR 200.00

Children (below 18 years): LKR 50.00

School Children (6–18 years in uniform): LKR 20.00

Children below 6 years in Preschool uniform / Clergy / Differently abled people: Free

Ticket Prices (Foreign):

Foreign Adults: US$ 15.00

Foreign Children (6–18 years): US$ 10.00

Contact Information:

Address: SLAF Museum, Colombo Road, Ratmalana Air Force Base, Sri Lanka

Phone: +94 772 444 445

Email: museum@airforce.lk

Tips for Visitors:

Visitors are encouraged to allow 2–3 hours to fully explore the exhibits.

Important Security Notice: Because the museum is located within an active military base (Ratmalana Air Force Base), the compound is strictly demarcated. Visitors are strongly advised not to trespass into restricted areas and should check with the museum regarding authorization for photography and videography.

fields.name: Bellanwila Rajamaha Viharaya
fields.short_description: A Buddhist temple known for its sacred Bodhi tree.
fields.description: Bellanwila Rajamaha Viharaya is a Buddhist temple at Bellanwila, near Boralesgamuwa. The temple is known for its Bodhi tree and its religious and cultural traditions. It remains an active place of worship.
fields.opening_hours_note: Listed visitor hours; religious events may affect access.
fields.google_maps_query: Bellanwila Rajamaha Viharaya, Dehiwala Road, Boralesgamuwa, Sri Lanka
fields.visitor_information: Wear modest clothing for this active place of worship. Follow instructions about footwear and photography in sacred areas, and avoid interrupting prayers or ceremonies.

fields.short_description: A zoological garden with animal exhibits and educational displays.
fields.description: The National Zoological Gardens at Dehiwala is operated by the Department of National Zoological Gardens. Visitors can see a collection of mammals, birds, reptiles, and other animals. Check the official website for current visitor arrangements.

images.alt_text: Kalutara Bodhiya is an old Bodhi tree which is identified as one of the 32 saplings of Jaya Sri Maha Bodhi which was planted during the reign of king Devanampiyatissa in the 2nd century BC at Anuradhapura, Sri Lanka.

fields.name: Pearl Bay
fields.short_description: A premier water park and FIA-CIK certified karting circuit located in Bandaragama, Sri Lanka.
fields.description: Pearl Bay is Sri Lanka's first European-standard waterpark, featuring 16 water slides across four towers and three pools. The location also features SpeedBay, a 1.2 km FIA-CIK certified karting track, along with kids' areas, an air rifle shooting range, and dining options like The Titan restaurant and YumBay café.

fields.name: Richmond Castle
fields.short_description: An Edwardian mansion beside the Kalu Ganga near Kalutara.
fields.description:
Richmond Castle is a spectacular two-storey Edwardian mansion built between 1900 and 1910 by philanthropist Mudaliyar Arthur de Silva Wijesinghe Siriwardena.

Set on a 42-acre estate, the mansion features 16 rooms, 99 ornately decorated doors, and 34 windows with delicate glass panes depicting grapevines. The materials were imported globally, including a grand staircase built from Burma teak.

School Children (Local): LKR 10.00

Foreign Nationals: LKR 500.00

Note: All ticket income goes toward the benefit of orphaned children cared for on the estate.

Located about 3 km inland from Kalutara town.
